title: Ember-1 from Fireworks now available on AI Gateway
summary: Ember-1 from Fireworks is now available on AI Gateway . Ember-1 is a research preview reasoning model built on Kimi K3 for coding and agentic workflows. Fireworks reports approximately 40% fewer generated tokens than Kimi K3 at comparable quality across its evaluations. For coding agents that make repeated model calls, shorter reasoning traces can reduce output costs and the amount of context carried into later steps. Ember-1 supports a 1M-token context window, text and image
